The handler configuration is cached for the transaction. In a test without `SeeAllData` the `npsp__Trigger_Handler__c` records that exist in the org are not visible, so the first call to `npsp.TDTM_Config_API.getCachedRecords()` primes the static cache and returns the list the dispatcher will use for the remainder of the transaction. Adding your own handler record to that in-memory list is the way to register it for the current transaction while keeping the NPSP defaults in the cache.

Adding the dedicated integration user’s username to that field on the Opportunity `RLLP_OppRollup_TDTM` handler skips the legacy rollup logic only for the ETL loads authenticated as that user. Staff users are unaffected during the day and no code change is required. The nightly NPSP scheduled rollup batch will still recalculate the totals.
